2609.34475.title: Causal Routing for Unlearning
2609.34475.paper_summary: LLMs cannot forget the way we delete a file. Strangely, we are asked to remove something that was never put anywhere in particular. What the model took from a piece of text is now smeared across billions of weights. Existing methods rewrite all of them to change one thing, and none of them say which part produced that change. To address this, we introduce Causal Routing for Unlearning (CRU) by asking where the concept is expressed in the model and suppressing only that part. One untrained forward pass over the forget set ranks neurons by how their activations vary. Then, small routing modules on those neurons gate and suppress only the concepts that need to be forgotten. In CRU, the base model is frozen, and any change in behavior is caused only by the gated neurons; hence, why the routing is causal. Due to our parameter efficiency (only ~0.01% as many parameters as the base model), unlearning a concept costs 14 GiB, whereas the baselines require 71 GiB. On TOFU, CRU is indistinguishable from the retained model (p > 0.05, KS test) and is never Pareto-dominated, whereas every compared baseline matches its forgetting on the larger-forget batches only by collapsing utility. On RWKU, it achieves an adversarial-probe recall of 0.052, compared to 0.250 for the strongest baseline, meaning the knowledge is gone, not merely harder to reach. Thus, deciding on the intervention at query time, rather than fixing it beforehand, is the axis along which we argue that unlearning should proceed.
2609.34475.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 無法像刪除檔案那樣忘記。奇怪的是，我們被要求移除一些從未特別放置的東西。模型從一段文本中提取的內容現在散佈在數十億個權重上。現有的方法重寫所有這些權重以改變一個東西，但沒有一個方法指出是哪個部分產生了該變化。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了因果路由以進行遺忘（Causal Routing for Unlearning, CRU），通過詢問概念在模型中表達的位置並僅抑制該部分。對遺忘集進行一次未訓練的前向傳播，根據神經元的激活變化對其進行排名。然後，這些神經元上的小型路由模塊僅對需要被遺忘的概念進行閘控和抑制。在 CRU 中，基礎模型是凍結的，任何行為的改變僅由被閘控的神經元引起；因此，路由是因果的。由於我們的參數效率（僅約為基礎模型的 0.01%），遺忘一個概念的成本為 14 GiB，而基準模型需要 71 GiB。在 TOFU 上，CRU 與保留模型無法區分（p > 0.05，KS 測試），且從未被 Pareto 支配，而每個比較的基準模型僅通過崩潰效用來匹配其在較大遺忘批次上的遺忘。在 RWKU 上，它的對抗性探測召回率為 0.052，而最強基準的召回率為 0.250，這意味著知識已經消失，而不僅僅是更難以獲得。因此，在查詢時決定干預，而不是事先修正，是我們主張遺忘應該進行的軸心。
